description: This file defines a theme configuration for a Flutter application, including color schemes and styling for various UI components.

classes.name: ColorScheme
classes.description: Defines the color palette for the app's theme, including primary, secondary, error, and surface colors.

classes.name: ThemeData
classes.description: Encapsulates the overall theme configuration, including color scheme, text styles, app bar, card, input decoration, button, and chip themes.

classes.name: TextTheme
classes.description: Specifies the text styles used across different text elements in the app.

classes.name: AppBarTheme
classes.description: Configures the appearance of AppBar widgets.

classes.name: ElevatedButtonThemeData
classes.description: Defines the style for elevated buttons.

methods.name: buildAppTheme
methods.description: Constructs and returns a ThemeData object configured with custom colors and styles for the app.
